interpretation.bank_baseline: linear; only prefix shared staging bank permutation changes
interpretation.profile_subset: panel c: FWHT N16 B16, all global modes; panel d: prefix only, both bank requests/modes; all kernels retained
interpretation.profile_timing: NCU duration is diagnostic and never used for timing ratios
interpretation.execution_groups: logical plan descriptors; generic grid_ctas is not an observed physical launch count; use NCU actual_launch for physical grid/block
